title: The exact Bloch coefficient for three-dimensional finite-range quantum ferromagnets
exact_target: For every positive half-integer spin S and each admissible nonnegative finite-range translation-invariant coupling on $Z^3$ with positive spin-stiffness matrix $D_{S,J}$, does $\beta ^{3/2}(S-m_{S,J}(\beta ))$ tend as beta$\to$infinity to $\zeta (3/2)/(8\pi ^{3/2}\operatorname{sqrt}(det$ $D_{S,J}))$?
